import type { Price } from "../commerce/price"
import type { Order } from "../commerce/price"
import type { WalletApi } from "./contracts"

/** 用同一 Mock 服务事务维护余额与订单，重复确认不会重复扣减。 */
export function createWalletMock(
  actor: () => string | null,
  initial: Readonly<Record<string, Price>>,
  settle: (id: string, debit: (price: Price) => void) => Order
): WalletApi {
  const balances = new Map(Object.entries(initial).map(([id, balance]) => [id, { ...balance }]))
  const requests = new Map<string, { orderId: string; order: Order }>()
  /** 钱包只读取当前认证主体，不接受页面提交的账户覆盖。 */
  function balance() {
    const subject = actor()
    const value = subject ? balances.get(subject) : undefined
    if (!subject || !value) throw new Error("wallet_unavailable")
    return { subject, value }
  }
  return {
    /** 读取当前主体和范围的显式数据，缺失授权失败关闭。 */
    async read(signal) {
      signal?.throwIfAborted()
      return { ...balance().value }
    },
    /** 按原订单和独立幂等关联原子扣款并确认结果。 */
    async pay(orderId, requestId) {
      const { subject, value } = balance()
      const key = JSON.stringify([subject, requestId])
      const previous = requests.get(key)
      if (previous) {
        if (previous.orderId !== orderId) throw new Error("idempotency_conflict")
        return structuredClone(previous.order)
      }
      const order = settle(orderId, (price) => {
        if (
          value.currency !== price.currency ||
          !Number.isSafeInteger(price.minor) ||
          price.minor < 0 ||
          value.minor < price.minor
        )
          throw new Error("wallet_insufficient")
        value.minor -= price.minor
      })
      requests.set(key, { orderId, order: structuredClone(order) })
      return order
    }
  }
}
